item.title: Indian cricket fraternity congratulates J&K for lifting maiden Ranji Trophy title by beating Karnataka in final
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir on Saturday (February 28) created history by lifting the Ranji Trophy title for the first time in their history by defeating Karnataka in the tournament final. After opting to bat, J&K racked up a mammoth 584 runs in their first innings on the back of a dominant batting performance where five batters scored 50-plus runs. item.title: CM Omar Abdullah announces cash prize; PM Modi congratulates as J&K lifts Ranji Trophy title for first time
item.description: Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Saturday (February 28) announced a cash prize worth INR 2 crore for the Jammu and Kashmir cricket team for winning the Ranji Trophy title for the first time. Abdullah termed it as a watershed moment for Jammu and Kashmir cricket, adding that the historic triumph has filled the entire region with pride and inspiration. item.description: After losing to South Africa by 76 runs, Team India are facing a must-win situation in their remaining Super 8 fixtures to make the T20 World Cup 2026 semifinals. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Sanath Jayasuriya plans to step down as Sri Lanka head coach after team’s Super 8 exit
item.description: Sri Lanka head coach Sanath Jayasuriya has decided to step down from his position following the team’s dismal show in the ongoing ICC Men’s T20 World Cup. The announcement came shortly after Sri Lanka completed their Super 8 campaign with a narrow five-run loss to Pakistan in Pallekele. The tournament co-hosts couldn’t win any of their Group 2 Super 8 fixtures, leaving the fans disappointed.
